sentences.text:
This petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is directed against order dated 22.07.2015 passed by Adjudicating Officer-Cum-Additional District Magistrate, Dholpur(for short 'the trial court')
whereby the trial court returned the S.B. CRIMINAL MISC. PETITION NO. 5492/2015 complaint filed by the Food Safety Officer instead of dismissing the same.
Learned counsel for the petitioners argued that the complaint in the present case was filed after more than one year and, therefore, it was barred by limitation.
The trial court ought not to have required the Food Safety Officer to approach the competent authority for extension of limitation and complaint should have been dismissed by simiplicitor order.

Learned Public Prosecutor opposed the petition and submitted that the trial court has merely invited attention of the Food Safety Officer towards proviso to Section 77 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006(for short 'the Act of 2006') which empowers the Commissioner of Food Safety to extend period of limitation up to three years.
Be that as it may, learned trial court, while returning the complaint, should have merely observed with regard to aforesaid provision, but not issued any specific direction.
It should have left to the Food Security Officer to approach the Commissioner of Food Safety.

Therefore, the impugned order is modified in terms that the Commissioner of Food Safety would not take any influence from the order S.B. CRIMINAL MISC. PETITION NO. 5492/2015 passed by the trial court and would in his own discretion decide whether to extend period of limitation up to three years upon considering merits of the case.
With the aforesaid observation, present petition stands disposed off.
Stay application also stands disposed off.

(MOHAMMAD RAFIQ),J.
Manoj, S.NO.28.
